summary: Strong runner-up and the better choice when inputs may be cyclic or contain Map/Set. Best type inference in the field, zero deps, active, published with SLSA provenance. Falls short only on release ergonomics: it authenticates with a long-lived NPM_TOKEN rather than OIDC trusted publishing.
reasoning: Handles circular references and merges Map/Set contents, which @fastify/deepmerge does not.
Most precise inferred types: optionality preserved and conflicting keys resolve to the right-hand type.
SLSA v1 provenance from .github/workflows/release.yml; lint, unit, type and type-test jobs must pass before the release job runs.
Active: 8.0.2 released 2026-08-21 with 0 open issues and 0 open PRs.
caveats: Release job uses an NPM_TOKEN secret rather than OIDC trusted publishing; a leaked token is a real, if manageable, risk.
280 KB installed because it ships ESM, CJS and source maps; about 8x the Fastify package.
Slower at ~196k ops/s on our workload.
Single maintainer (RebeccaStevens); bus factor of one.

evidence.label: CI publish pipeline
evidence.detail: release.yml runs on push to main after all lint/test/typecheck jobs, then pnpm release (semantic-release). Authenticates with secrets.NPM_TOKEN.

evidence.detail: ~196k ops/s. Handles cycles and deep nesting. Merges Map/Set. Arrays concat. undefined does not overwrite.
